arg.name: vehicle_id
arg.description: REQUIRED: which physical car, car_a, car_b or car_c -- an individual_params/config/VEHICLE_ID/ instance. Its autosdv_vehicle/actuator.param.yaml loads last into the actuator and the gear manager, so the car's measured neutral, brake and steering points win over actuator.yaml and actuator_param_overrides; the cars differ in their stop PWM, and the wrong one drives a car instead of stopping it. Autoware's vehicle.launch.xml always passes it.

arg.name: hardware
arg.description: real: PCA9685 over I2C and the hall sensor on Jetson.GPIO (the car). sim: the autosdv_rc_sim plant (SimPCA9685 writes to /rc_sim/pwm, SimGPIO reads /rc_sim/hall_edges)

arg.name: vehicle_info_param_file
arg.description: Vehicle geometry (wheel_base, wheel_tread, max_steer_angle); the file the planner uses

arg.name: speed_controller_class
arg.description: Inner loop, package.module:Class with reset() and update(target_speed, measured_speed, dt) -> PWM

arg.name: speed_controller_params
arg.description: The plug-in's own parameters as a YAML mapping string, e.g. {kp: 20.0, ki: 4.0}

arg.name: emergency_stop_on_any_mrm
arg.description: true: brake on ANY operating/succeeded MRM, comfortable stop included. Needed when the planner ignores the velocity limit a comfortable stop acts through (the Lab 2 pursuit planner). false: only on an emergency-stop or failed MRM, as vehicle_cmd_gate does

arg.name: launch_velocity_report
arg.description: the hall-sensor wheel speed node (needs Jetson.GPIO). false when something else publishes /vehicle/status/velocity_status, such as the Lab 2 vehicle bench's plant model

arg.name: launch_signal_manager
arg.description: turn indicator and hazard light status; nothing reads it in a stack without Autoware planning or the AD API vehicle adapters

arg.name: publish_operation_mode_availability
arg.description: true: control_mode_manager also publishes /system/operation_mode/availability, always 'autonomous available'. Off by default: Autoware's diagnostic graph converter owns that topic, and a second, unconditional publisher lets the MRM handler and engage read 'available' over a failed check. Only for a stack with no graph that still needs the topic

arg.name: speed_controller_dt_source
arg.description: dt handed to the plug-in: velocity_report (legacy; time since the last 20 Hz report, so ~3x effective ki at the 100 Hz loop) or loop (the loop period)

arg.name: actuator_param_overrides
arg.description: a param file loaded into the actuator after actuator.yaml, for per-launch overrides such as a measured tire_angle_to_steer_ratio (the Lab 2 waypoint launch). Default: actuator.yaml again, which changes nothing
